redfin.remarks: HUGE PRICE IMPROVEMENT! Experience elevated luxury living in this beautifully reimagined residence at 900 W. Olympic Blvd. #30A. Showcasing extensive designer upgrades throughout, this sophisticated high-rise home has been transformed with elegant, modern finishes that enhance both style and functionality. The entire residence now features stunning polished white porcelain marble tile flooring, creating a seamless, light-filled aesthetic that flows throughout the living spaces and bedrooms. The kitchen has been upgraded with a luxurious polished white marble countertop at the breakfast bar, complemented by a new range and upgraded refrigerator, making it as functional as it is beautiful. Every bathroom has been refreshed with new tile finishes, while sparkling crystal chandeliers add an elegant touch to the main living room, bedroom hallway, primary bathroom, and powder room. Fresh interior paint throughout provides a crisp, contemporary feel. The spacious primary suite has been enhanced with newly installed custom closets for improved organization and storage. Additional upgrades include a brand-new washer and dryer, completing this truly move-in-ready residence. Stunning views from almost every room in the condo truly bring the essence of what it means to live here. Located in one of Downtown Los Angeles' premier luxury high-rise communities, this exceptional home offers refined finishes, timeless elegance, and an elevated lifestyle in the heart of the city. As a resident of The Ritz-Carlton Residences, enjoy legendary five-star amenities including 24-hour concierge, doorman, and valet parking. Indulge in the private rooftop oasis featuring a heated saltwater pool, cabanas, and a resident lounge with a catering kitchen. Stay active in the state-of-the-art fitness center or unwind at the world-class Ritz-Carlton Spa. Additional perks include a private screening room, executive boardroom, and daily complimentary breakfast. Live steps away from Crypto.com Arena, L. A. Live, and DTLA’s finest dining and entertainment.
